faq.heading: Questions, answered

order.q: In what order do I use the routine?
order.a: Cleanser, then Clarity Serum, then Daily Barrier Moisturizing Cream — morning and night. In the morning, finish with Daily Defense Sunscreen SPF 50+ as the last step.

am_pm.q: Can I use the products morning and night?
am_pm.a: The cleanser, serum and moisturizer are used morning and night. The sunscreen is a morning step.

reapply.q: How often should I reapply sunscreen?
reapply.a: The pack direction is to reapply every 2 hours.

inci.q: Where can I see the full ingredient list?
inci.a: On every product page, under “Full ingredients (INCI)” — exactly as printed on the pack.

skin_type.q: Which skin types are they for?
skin_type.a: The cleanser and the moisturizer are formulated for oily to combination skin. The sunscreen is for all skin types.

made.q: Where are Between Two Suns products made?
made.a: In Egypt. They are manufactured by Integrated Cosmetics Industries for Nuu Group for Cosmetics.

climate.a: Skincare designed around the conditions skin actually lives in — sun, pollution, dust, humidity, heat, air-con and constant change — with light textures and a simple four-step routine.

fragrance.a: The Daily Barrier Moisturizing Cream is labelled fragrance-free. Each product page lists the full ingredients so you can check.

payment.a: The payment methods available for your order are shown at checkout before you confirm.

cr_followers.q: Do I need a lot of followers?
cr_followers.a: No. We look at how honest and well-made your content is, not just the numbers.

cr_paid.a: Every accepted creator gets the full routine. Depending on the collaboration, it can also include commission on sales through your code, or a paid project. We agree everything with you before you post.

cr_rights.a: Only with your permission. If we’d like to use a piece on our site, channels or ads, we ask first and agree how, where and for how long.

cr_post.a: We ask for honest content after you’ve lived with the routine for a while. What and when, we agree together. We never script your opinion.

cr_where.a: Creators based in Egypt, for now. Any platform, any follower count.

cr_disclose.q: Do I need to mark posts as an ad?
cr_disclose.a: Yes. Mark gifted or paid posts the way your platform asks, for example with the paid-partnership label or #ad.

spf_last.q: Where does sunscreen go in my routine?
spf_last.a: Last, every morning: after the moisturizer. The pack direction is to reapply every 2 hours.

set_full_size.q: Are the products in a set full-size?
set_full_size.a: Yes. A set holds the same full-size products sold on their own: cleanser 200 mL, serum 30 mL, moisturizer 50 g, sunscreen 50 g.

set_saving.q: How is the saving worked out?
set_saving.a: Against buying the same products separately at today’s prices. The set price is the price you pay; it is shown before you add it to your bag.

start_where.q: Which set should I start with?
start_where.a: Starting from nothing: The Full Ritual, all four steps for morning and night. Want to start smaller: the Clear & Protect Trio. Oil and sun: the Clear & Protect Duo. Or pick single steps on the Sets page.

all_four.q: Do I need all four steps?
all_four.a: No. Start with the steps you need and add the rest when you want. Used together they go in order: cleanser, serum, moisturizer, then sunscreen as the last step in the morning.

delivery_free.a: Standard delivery is free on eligible orders of {{ amount }} or more. The delivery cost for your order is shown at checkout before you pay.

returns.a: What can be returned, and how, is set out in our refund policy:

contact_reply.a: Send us a message from the Contact page or email us. We reply by email.

inci_what.a: The International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients: the standard names used on cosmetic labels, so an ingredient list reads the same in every country.

ingredients_order.a: Ingredient lists name ingredients from the largest amount down. Water is the base of most formulas, so it usually comes first.

ac_steps.q: What should I use for long days in air-con?
ac_steps.a: Our pick for air-con days is Daily Barrier Moisturizing Cream with Clarity Serum. The Climate page shows the steps we pair with each condition.

delivery_time.a: Cairo and Giza: {{ main }} business days. Other governorates: {{ other }} business days. Business days are Sunday to Thursday, excluding public holidays. These are estimates, not guarantees.

delivery_cost.a: Standard delivery is {{ fee }}, and free on orders of {{ amount }} or more (after discounts).
delivery_cost.remote: Remote areas pay {{ remote }}, or {{ remote_over }} on orders of {{ amount }} or more.
delivery_cost.remote_free: Remote areas pay {{ remote }}; on orders of {{ amount }} or more, delivery is free everywhere.
delivery_cost.checkout: The exact cost for your address is shown at checkout before you pay.

cod.q: Can I pay cash on delivery?
cod.a: Yes. Cash on delivery is available at no extra charge. Please have the exact amount ready for the courier.

sensitive.q: Are the products suitable for sensitive skin?
sensitive.a: Some of our formulas include ingredients commonly used for hydration and barrier support, such as ceramides, panthenol, glycerin and centella asiatica. Sensitivity varies from person to person, so we can't promise every product will suit all sensitive skin. Introduce one product at a time and patch test first: apply a little to a small area, such as the inner arm, and wait at least 24 hours.

shelf_life.q: How long do the products last once opened?

authenticity.q: How do I know my product is genuine?

pregnancy.q: Can I use the products during pregnancy or breastfeeding?
pregnancy.a: We don't describe any of our products as pregnancy-safe. Please consult your doctor or a healthcare professional before using them during pregnancy or breastfeeding, especially before starting the Clarity Serum.
